record.question: Under one of the categories, Mizoram recently received the award 'Best Performing state' under JNNURM from Central government. The category includes –
options: Special category states, NE states and UTs only
record.explanation: Mizoram is officially classified as a Special Category State in the Indian planning framework, and received the JNNURM 'Best Performing State' award under this category.
